name: Coliseum
summary:
The best thing that could ever happen in your miserable life has just happened to you. And possibly the last, but let's not ruin the mood with spoilers.

You’ve been kidnapped and dragged into the Coliseum. No, no, not that historical ruin for tourists. Everything here is the real deal: blood, betting, the roar of the crowd, and people who genuinely believe human suffering is top-tier entertainment.

The rules are simple: survive, entertain, kill (my favorite part).

Yeah, yeah, don't make that face. Show them how dangerous, special, and invincible you are. Or at least try not to look like the most pathetic piece of meat in this arena. We don't just grab anyone off the street, you know. The Coliseum does have standards. Extremely low, but they exist!

Look around. Meet the other contestants. Face the trials.

If you get lucky—they will remember you. If not… well. Our cleaners work fast.
